name: kino-plugin-hdfull
description: HDFull: source in src/ (the plugin + the standard screen in src/std), bundled into plugin.js. Consumes kino-resolver.

scripts.build: esbuild src/plugin.js --bundle --format=esm --target=es2020 --outfile=plugin.js "--banner:js=// Generated by npm run build from src/. Do not edit this file: edit src/ and rebuild."
scripts.validate: npm run build && node sdk/validate.mjs . --repo xuper-plugin/kino-plugin-hdfull
